title: Casual Quiz
lead: Easy multiple-choice questions to pass the time. Switch topic or level whenever you like. Marks stay in this browser only.
howToAdd: Add objects to topics, levels, or questions. A topic with mix:true (General) automatically includes every other topic. answer must match one options string exactly. id must be unique kebab-case. The page reads this file only — no code changes needed.

topics.name: General
topics.blurb: A mix of every topic, shuffled.

topics.name: Cinema

questions.question: What is the capital of India?
questions.hint: Parliament and Rashtrapati Bhavan are here.
questions.explain: New Delhi is the capital of India.

questions.question: What is the currency of India?
questions.hint: Its symbol looks like a mix of R and the Latin letter.
questions.explain: India uses the Indian Rupee (INR).

questions.question: The Taj Mahal is in which city?
questions.hint: It sits on the banks of the Yamuna in Uttar Pradesh.
questions.explain: The Taj Mahal is in Agra.

questions.question: What is the national animal of India?
questions.hint: It is a striped big cat.
questions.explain: The Bengal tiger is India's national animal.

questions.question: In which year did India become independent?
questions.hint: It is 15 August of this year.
questions.explain: India gained independence on 15 August 1947.

questions.question: Which ocean lies to the south of India?
questions.hint: It shares the country's name.
questions.explain: The Indian Ocean borders India to the south.

questions.question: Who was the first Prime Minister of independent India?
questions.hint: He is often called Chacha Nehru.
questions.explain: Jawaharlal Nehru was the first Prime Minister.

questions.question: How many states does India have (as commonly counted today)?
questions.hint: Union territories are counted separately.
questions.explain: India currently has 28 states and 8 union territories.

questions.question: Which river is widely known as India's longest?
questions.hint: It is also called the Ganges.
questions.explain: The Ganga is commonly named India's longest river.

questions.question: Which city is often called the Silicon Valley of India?
questions.hint: It is the capital of Karnataka.
questions.explain: Bengaluru is widely called India's Silicon Valley.

questions.question: What is the national flower of India?
questions.hint: It grows in ponds and is used in many temple offerings.
questions.explain: The lotus is India's national flower.

questions.question: Which is the highest mountain peak in India?
questions.hint: It stands on the India–Nepal border in Sikkim.
questions.explain: Kangchenjunga is the highest peak wholly in India (Everest is in Nepal/China).

questions.question: Who wrote India's national anthem, Jana Gana Mana?
questions.hint: He also wrote Bangladesh's national anthem.
questions.explain: Rabindranath Tagore wrote Jana Gana Mana.

questions.question: India's first satellite was named after which ancient astronomer?
questions.hint: It launched in 1975.
questions.explain: Aryabhata was India's first satellite.

questions.question: In which year did Goa become part of India?
questions.hint: It followed the end of Portuguese rule.
questions.explain: Goa was integrated into India in 1961.

questions.question: The Charminar is a landmark of which city?
questions.hint: The monument has four minarets.
questions.explain: The Charminar stands in Hyderabad.

questions.question: Which state is often called the Spice Garden of India?

questions.explain: Kerala is widely known as the Spice Garden of India.

questions.question: Who is known as the Missile Man of India?

questions.explain: A. P. J. Abdul Kalam is called the Missile Man of India.

questions.question: What is the capital of Tamil Nadu?

questions.question: Bharatanatyam is a classical dance of which state?

questions.question: Marina Beach is in which city?

questions.question: Pongal is mainly a festival of which state?
questions.hint: It is a harvest festival in January.
questions.explain: Pongal is Tamil Nadu's harvest festival.

questions.question: Filter coffee is a popular drink in which Indian state?

questions.question: The Meenakshi Amman Temple is in which city?

questions.question: Udhagamandalam is better known as which hill station?

questions.question: The Shore Temple is at which coastal town?

questions.question: Tamil Nadu's state animal is which mountain goat?

questions.question: What is the chemical formula of water?

questions.question: The SI unit of force is the…

questions.question: Which company makes the iPhone?

questions.question: CPU stands for…

questions.question: Wi-Fi is mainly used to…

questions.question: An animated film is created mainly with…
questions.hint: Think of cartoon features.
questions.explain: Animation uses drawings or CGI.

questions.question: The Cannes Film Festival is held in which country?
questions.hint: It is on the French Riviera.
questions.explain: Cannes is in France.

questions.question: Ilaiyaraaja is celebrated for…
questions.hint: He scored hundreds of South Indian films.
questions.explain: Ilaiyaraaja is a film-music composer.

questions.question: Dadasaheb Phalke is remembered as the father of…
questions.hint: Raja Harishchandra is linked to him.
questions.explain: Dadasaheb Phalke is the father of Indian cinema.

questions.question: The film Nayakan is primarily in which language?
questions.hint: Kamal Haasan starred in this Mani Ratnam classic.
questions.explain: Nayakan is a Tamil film.

questions.question: Kodambakkam in Chennai is historically linked to…
questions.hint: Kollywood's name comes from this area.
questions.explain: Kodambakkam is a historic film-studio neighbourhood.

questions.question: Who directed the film Parasakthi (1952), a landmark Tamil drama?
questions.hint: Sivaji Ganesan's debut, written by Karunanidhi.
questions.explain: Parasakthi was directed by Krishnan–Panju.

questions.question: The Palme d'Or is the top prize at which festival?
questions.hint: The name is French for a golden palm.
questions.explain: The Palme d'Or is awarded at Cannes.

questions.question: Kamal Haasan is known as a leading actor in which industry?
questions.hint: He has also worked in other Indian languages.
questions.explain: Kamal Haasan is a Tamil cinema star.

questions.question: The Moon orbits which body?
questions.hint: We see phases each month.
questions.explain: The Moon orbits Earth.

questions.question: Who was the first person to walk on the Moon?
questions.hint: The mission was Apollo 11.
questions.explain: Neil Armstrong was first on the Moon.

questions.question: Our galaxy is called the…
questions.hint: On a dark night it looks like a pale band.
questions.explain: We live in the Milky Way.

questions.question: The closest star to Earth is the…
questions.hint: It lights our day.
questions.explain: The Sun is the closest star.

questions.question: ISRO is the space agency of which country?
questions.hint: Its headquarters are in Bengaluru.
questions.explain: ISRO is India's space agency.

questions.question: Stars appear to shine because they…
questions.hint: They are giant balls of hot gas.
questions.explain: Stars produce their own light.

questions.question: Mars is often called the…
questions.hint: Iron-rich dust gives it colour.
questions.explain: Mars is the Red Planet.

questions.question: Saturn is famous for its…
questions.hint: A telescope shows them clearly.
questions.explain: Saturn is known for its rings.

questions.question: Chandrayaan is India's programme to explore the…
questions.hint: The name comes from Sanskrit for moon vehicle.
questions.explain: Chandrayaan is India's Moon programme.

questions.question: A year on Earth is the time it takes to…
questions.hint: That trip is about 365 days.
questions.explain: A year is one orbit around the Sun.

questions.question: Stars are made mostly of which gas?
questions.hint: Fusion in the core turns it into helium.
questions.explain: Stars are mostly hydrogen.

questions.question: The International Space Station is…
questions.hint: Astronauts live there for months.
questions.explain: The ISS is a laboratory in orbit.

questions.question: A light-year measures…
questions.hint: It is how far light travels in one year.
questions.explain: A light-year is a unit of distance.

questions.question: Who was the first Indian in space?
questions.hint: He flew on a Soviet mission in 1984.
questions.explain: Rakesh Sharma was the first Indian in space.

questions.question: The Hubble instrument is a…
questions.hint: It orbits Earth and photographs distant galaxies.
questions.explain: Hubble is a space telescope.

questions.question: A black hole is known for its…
questions.hint: Not even light can escape from inside it.
questions.explain: A black hole has extremely strong gravity.

questions.question: Which planet is closest to the Sun?
questions.hint: It is the smallest planet as well.
questions.explain: Mercury is closest to the Sun.

questions.question: Mangalyaan was India's mission to which planet?
questions.hint: It is also called the Mars Orbiter Mission.
questions.explain: Mangalyaan went to Mars.
